The common ratio is $r=-3,$ so we can start writing the formula for the $n$th term of the sequence:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}\cdot {r}^{n-1} \\  & ={a}_{1}\cdot (-3)^{n-1}\end{aligned}
$$

However, we still need to figure out the first term ${a}_{1}.$ We know that the $4$th term is ${a}_{4}=-135,$ so we can solve for the first term as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{4} & ={a}_{1}\cdot (-3)^{4-1} \\ -135 & ={a}_{1}\cdot (-3)^{3} \\ -135 & ={a}_{1}\cdot (-27) \\ 5 & ={a}_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

Now that we know the first term is ${a}_{1}=5,$ we can complete the formula for the $n$th term of the sequence:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}\cdot {5}^{n-1} \\  & =5(-3)^{n-1}\end{aligned}
$$
